pages.text:
Arabic Voice Intelligence Platform for Enterprise Contact Centers
Transcribe, analyze, monitor, and search Arabic conversations with AI built for enterprise contact centers and business operations.
Real-time transcription, under 150 milliseconds.
A streaming-first architecture that turns speech into text instantly, with sub-dialect accuracy, even in noisy real-world environments.
Live, low-latency transcription
140 ms average latency, full-duplex streaming, and partial-result updates as words arrive.
Voice activity detection
Automatically detect when speech starts and stops, segmenting sessions for clean downstream processing.
Speaker diarization with voiceprints
Real-time speaker labels powered by neural voiceprints. We re-identify the same speakers across calls, meetings, and multi-party conversations.
Sub-dialect accuracy
Trained at the neighborhood, city, and generational level, not just 23 country dialects.
Products built on top of our voice models.
Alongside our cloud ASR APIs, we ship ready-to-use products that solve specific enterprise needs.
AliveArchive
Turn your organization's audio and video archive into a searchable, indexed knowledge base. Calls, meetings, broadcasts, interviews.
✓ Arabic semantic search
✓ Auto-summaries per file
✓ Speaker and event tagging
✓ Shazam-like voiceprint search
Call Center Monitor
Automatically monitor and score every single call against your QA criteria. No more random sampling.
✓ 100% of calls evaluated
✓ Customizable compliance rules
✓ Customer and agent sentiment
✓ Real-time alerts on rule failures
The call processing pipeline
Five steps, from upload to team-level executive insights.
Enterprise-grade security and infrastructure at scale
Security at the level of the largest enterprises, on infrastructure built to scale.
Enterprise-level data protection
Encrypted in transit and at rest. SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. Gulf and Jordan data residency, zero-retention mode available.
Granular team permissions
Fine-grained roles, shared glossaries across teams, SSO and SAML integration.
Elevated support and custom deployments
An engineering team in Amman ensures smooth launches, with cloud, on-prem, and hybrid deployment options.
Four technologies powering everything we ship
Take a closer look at the voice infrastructure behind our products: word alignment, voiceprints, audio-domain PII masking, and Fourier-based speaker separation.

The most accurate Arabic speech-to-text platform. Built in Amman to serve 400 million speakers.
The technologies that make Aljawab possible
We build Arabic voice models from scratch. Here's a closer look at four technologies we develop in-house, and how each one shows up in the product.
We know exactly where every word was spoken in the audio.
Every word in the transcript carries a precise (start, end) timestamp inside the audio clip. That unlocks interactive players, word-level archive search, and moment extraction.
✓ Word-level timestamps at ~10 ms resolution.
✓ Forced alignment for batch files as a fallback to the streaming model.
✓ Monotonic alignment constraint prevents overlap or backtracking.
✓ Per-word confidence scores flag transcripts that deserve review.
Find a person by voice across thousands of hours.
We turn every voice into a numerical vector (a voiceprint) and search for the closest matches in your archive, with a similarity score that respects how voices change over time. Used primarily inside AliveArchive.
✓ 256-dimensional embedding per speaker.
✓ Cosine-similarity ranking over an HNSW vector index.
✓ Time-decay re-weighting tolerates voice drift across years.
✓ Auto-alerts on matches above a configurable similarity threshold.
We mask sensitive content on the audio itself, live or batch.
Not only in the transcript. We detect sensitive entities (names, numbers, addresses, IDs) and mask them on the waveform directly, during live streaming or over whole files.
✓ Entity detection runs directly on the streaming token graph.
✓ Audio-domain masking via a spectral notch or constant-pitch beep overlay.
✓ Per-entity-class redaction policies (PHI, PII, financial).
✓ Live during call-center conversations and batch over archives.
We count the speakers, then separate them with the Fourier transform.
We use voiceprints to estimate how many speakers are in the audio, then split the signal into independent per-speaker channels via the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT).
✓ Voiceprint clustering auto-estimates the number of speakers N.
✓ Frame-by-frame assignment to the closest speaker in voiceprint space.
✓ DFT on overlapping frames separates concurrent speakers.
✓ Clean per-speaker channel out, ready for transcription.
What dialects does Aljawab support? +
Does Aljawab detect speakers automatically? + Yes. Speaker diarization is on by default and runs in real time for live calls, and in batch for meeting and interview files.
Does Aljawab handle Arabic-English code-switching? + Yes. The model handles code-switching between Arabic and English seamlessly, common in technical and business calls.
How does Aljawab secure my data? + All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We're SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. Zero-retention mode is available for all customers, with data residency options in Jordan, UAE, or Saudi Arabia.
